AIAssistant.howItWorksDesc: Configure your assistant and when someone sends you a WhatsApp message, the bot will automatically reply using AI. Each user can use their own Groq API key (free and fast).
AIAssistant.guideStep1Desc: Go to console.groq.com/keys and create a free account. Groq is fast and has generous free limits.
AIAssistant.guideStep2Desc: Click "Configure AI", enter your API key and a prompt describing how the bot should behave.
AIAssistant.guideStep3Desc: Use the "Test" button to verify it works. Then toggle the switch to start responding automatically.
AIAssistant.proTipDesc: Enable "Auto-enhance Prompt" so the system automatically adds best practices to your prompt, even if it's very simple.
AIAssistant.selectDeviceDesc: Select the WhatsApp device to configure AI assistants
AIAssistant.standaloneDesc: Configure bots without a WhatsApp device — for embeddable widgets, web chats, and more
